verdict.rationale: Pandoc ships an official Haskell library alongside the CLI (pandoc-docs-17), so developers can build against a first-party programmatic library. Its documented Lua API for filters and custom readers/writers (pandoc-docs-15, pandoc-docs-16) adds an official extension surface, but the evidence shows only one host-language library rather than a set of official SDKs. Missing for 10: official SDKs in mainstream languages beyond Haskell (e.g. Python/JS), SDK reference documentation in the evidence, and independent corroboration of building against the library.
